sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是99%隐秘世界。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗马·马尔斯。

sentences.en: A man walks down a dark alley.
sentences.zh: 一个男人走在一条黑暗的小巷里。

sentences.en: He's dressed all in black.
sentences.zh: 他一身黑衣。

sentences.en: Black beanie hat, black gloves.
sentences.zh: 黑色毛线帽，黑色手套。

sentences.en: He approaches a door, drops to one knee,
sentences.zh: 他走近一扇门，单膝跪地，

sentences.en: and produces from his pocket a small metal tool.
sentences.zh: 从口袋里掏出一个小型金属工具。

sentences.en: He inserts the tool into the keyhole.
sentences.zh: 他将工具插入钥匙孔。

sentences.en: He deftly slides the tool around inside the keyhole.
sentences.zh: 他灵巧地将工具在钥匙孔内部滑动。

sentences.en: Until...
sentences.zh: 直到……

sentences.en: He's in.
sentences.zh: 他进去了。

sentences.en: Security has been breached.
sentences.zh: 安保被突破了。

sentences.en: But only in the movies, because, prospective lock pickers take note,
sentences.zh: 但这只发生在电影里，因为，潜在的开锁新手请注意，

sentences.en: you generally can't do that with just a pick, or a hairpin, or a paperclip.
sentences.zh: 你通常无法仅凭一把锁匠工具、一个发卡或一个回形针就做到这一点。

sentences.en: There are two tools you need to pick a lock, and one of them is usually left out.
sentences.zh: 开锁需要两样工具，而其中一样通常会被忽略。

sentences.en: When you see people picking locks in movies, this is the part they always forget.
sentences.zh: 当你在电影里看到人们开锁时，这就是他们总是忘掉的那部分。

sentences.en: The tension wrench.
sentences.zh: 张力扳手。

sentences.en: This is a tension wrench.
sentences.zh: 这就是张力扳手。

sentences.en: It's an L-shaped piece of metal with a little twist in it.
sentences.zh: 它是一块带有一个小弯曲的L形金属片。

sentences.en: An L-shaped piece of metal that, with one hand, you insert at the bottom of the keyhole,
sentences.zh: 一块L形的金属片，一只手将其插入钥匙孔底部，

sentences.en: while the other hand uses the pick to work the pins in the lock.
sentences.zh: 同时另一只手用开锁器去拨动锁芯里的弹子。

sentences.en: And hold the lock with a little bit of rotational tension.
sentences.zh: 并用一点旋转张力稳住锁芯。

sentences.en: That, by the way, is Lee Honeywell, showing our producer Sam Greenspan how to pick a lock.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，那是李·亨尼韦尔，正在向我们的制作人萨姆·格林斯潘展示如何开锁。

sentences.en: Lee is a digital security expert and amateur lockpicking instructor.
sentences.zh: 李是一位数字安全专家兼业余开锁教练。

sentences.en: I taught a bunch of people how to pick locks at a feminist science fiction convention one year.
sentences.zh: 我曾于某年在一次女性主义科幻大会上教过一群人怎么开锁。

sentences.en: I met Lee at her office in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我在旧金山李的办公室见到了她。

sentences.en: We sat in a conference room among piles of tension wrenches and lock picks,
sentences.zh: 我们坐在会议室里，周围堆满了张力扳手、开锁器，

sentences.en: and special practice locks built for the picking.
sentences.zh: 以及专为开锁练习制造的练习锁。

sentences.en: You have to push each pin up far enough that you can't see that bottom part.
sentences.zh: 你必须把每个弹子往上推得足够高，以至于你看不到最下面那部分。

sentences.en: See how you can see the bottom part there?
sentences.zh: 看到你能看到那里的底部了吗？

sentences.en: There's two pieces of the pin you have to get.
sentences.zh: 弹子有两部分是你需要对准的。

sentences.en: So when you pick a lock, you're using the pick and tension wrench to do the work of the key.
sentences.zh: 所以当你开锁时，你是在用开锁器和张力扳手来起钥匙的作用。

sentences.en: You need them both.
sentences.zh: 这两样你都缺一不可。

sentences.en: It's okay, so I'm kind of putting the pick into the keyhole.
sentences.zh: 没关系，我正把开锁器放进钥匙孔里。

sentences.en: Oh, is that it?
sentences.zh: 哦，是这样吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I did it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我打开了。

sentences.en: Hey!
sentences.zh: 嘿！

sentences.en: Yay!
sentences.zh: 太棒了！

sentences.en: The pursuit of lockpicking is as old as the lock, which is itself as old as civilization.
sentences.zh: 对开锁的追求和锁本身一样古老，而锁本身又和文明一样古老。

sentences.en: But in the entire history of the world, there was only one brief moment, about 70 years,
sentences.zh: 但在整个人类历史中，曾经有过短暂的一段时期，大约70年，

sentences.en: where you could put something under lock and key, a chest, a safe, your home,
sentences.zh: 那时你可以把东西锁在箱子、保险箱、你的家里，并配上钥匙，

sentences.en: and have complete, unwavering certainty that no intruder could get to it.
sentences.zh: 并且拥有百分之百、坚定不移的确定性：没有任何入侵者能打开它。

sentences.en: A feeling that security experts call perfect security.
sentences.zh: 安全专家将这种感觉称为完美安全性。

sentences.en: And since we lost perfect security in the 1850s, it has remained elusive.
sentences.zh: 自从我们在19世纪50年代失去完美安全性以来，它就一直是个遥不可及的梦想。

sentences.en: Despite tremendous leaps forward in security technology,
sentences.zh: 尽管安全技术取得了巨大的飞跃，

sentences.en: we have never been able to get perfect security back.
sentences.zh: 我们却再也无法找回完美的安全性。

sentences.en: Locks go back at least as far as ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 锁的历史至少可以追溯到古埃及。

sentences.en: But in March, I'm dropping a big paper theorizing that the Mesopotamians were actually the creators
sentences.zh: 但在三月份，我将发表一篇长篇论文，推测美索不达米亚人其实才是

sentences.en: of the original lock and that the Egyptians then learned it from them.
sentences.zh: 最初的锁的创造者，然后埃及人是从他们那里学来的。

sentences.en: This is Skylar Towne.
sentences.zh: 这是斯凯勒·汤恩。

sentences.en: I am Skylar Towne, and I am a security anthropologist, research scholar with the Ronin Institute,
sentences.zh: 我是斯凯勒·汤恩，我是一名安全人类学家、罗宁研究所的研究学者，

sentences.en: but generally just an independent academic of all things related to locks.
sentences.zh: 但总体来说，我只是一个研究一切与锁相关事物的独立学者。

sentences.en: From the Middle Ages on, for hundreds of years, locks were not very good.
sentences.zh: 从中世纪开始的几百年里，锁其实并不怎么好用。

sentences.en: If you were poor, you could have a terrible lock.
sentences.zh: 如果你很穷，你可能会有一个糟糕的锁。

sentences.en: And if you had some money, you could have a terrible lock with some added features
sentences.zh: 而如果你有点钱，你可能会有一个带有附加功能的糟糕的锁，

sentences.en: that might, at best, confuse a trespasser.
sentences.zh: 充其量只能迷惑一下不速之客。

sentences.en: There are chests with false keyholes.
sentences.zh: 有些箱子带有假钥匙孔。

sentences.en: There are padlocks even with false keyholes.
sentences.zh: 甚至连挂锁也有假钥匙孔。

sentences.en: False keyholes, which they hoped would draw the thief away from the true keyhole.
sentences.zh: 假钥匙孔，他们希望这能把小偷引开，不去注意真正的钥匙孔。

sentences.en: Some locks had false keyholes that even had lock-like components affixed to them,
sentences.zh: 有些锁的假钥匙孔甚至还装有类似锁的部件，

sentences.en: so it felt like they were attached to the latching mechanism, but actually weren't.
sentences.zh: 让人感觉它们连接着闩锁机构，但实际上并没有。

sentences.en: Seriously, the best you could do was try to confuse an intruder into picking a fake lock.
sentences.zh: 说真的，你所能做的最好防范就是试图误导入侵者去撬一把假锁。

sentences.en: But as soon as the real keyhole was known, the security was pretty much nil.
sentences.zh: 但一旦真正的钥匙孔暴露，安全性基本上就归零了。

sentences.en: There was no perfect security.
sentences.zh: 根本没有什么完美的安全性。

sentences.en: There was no lock that could keep everyone out.
sentences.zh: 没有任何一把锁能把所有人挡在外面。

sentences.en: And then in the 1770s, an English guy named Joseph Brahma entered the locksmithing scene.
sentences.zh: 然后在18世纪70年代，一个名叫约瑟夫·布拉马的英国人进入了制锁界。

sentences.en: And this is like a wizard from the future had come back in time and invented the most amazing lock in the world.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个来自未来的巫师穿越回过去，发明了世界上最神奇的锁。

sentences.en: If the name Joseph Brahma sounds familiar to you fellow engineering history nerds,
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得“约瑟夫·布拉马”这个名字听起来很熟悉，你们这些工程史极客们，

sentences.en: this is the same Joseph Brahma who invented the flush toilet and the first water-pumping fire engine and...
sentences.zh: 这就是发明了抽水马桶、第一台抽水消防车以及……的那个约瑟夫·布拉马。

sentences.en: a pneumatic tree-murdering machine that would literally just rip a full-grown tree out of the ground by its roots.
sentences.zh: 一台能字面意义上把一棵成年大树连根拔起的 pneumatic（气动）毁树机器。

sentences.en: That one wasn't as popular, but it was pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 那个没那么受欢迎，但它确实挺酷的。

sentences.en: And so Joseph Brahma, inventor, time wizard, tree murderer, he was really interested in locks.
sentences.zh: 所以约瑟夫·布拉马，发明家、时间巫师、毁树者，他对锁非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: He made something called, aptly, the Brahma safety lock.
sentences.zh: 他制作了一种恰如其分地被称为“布拉马安全锁”的东西。

sentences.en: Brahma disconnected the key from the bolt.
sentences.zh: 布拉马将钥匙与锁栓分开了。

sentences.en: So what the key is doing is it's rotating an inner chamber of this lock.
sentences.zh: 钥匙所做的是旋转这个锁的内部腔室。

sentences.en: Take my word for it, explaining how this thing works does not make for a compelling radio.
sentences.zh: 听我的，解释这东西怎么运作可一点也算不上引人入胜的广播节目。

sentences.en: But the main thing about this lock is that it added levels of complexity in between the key and the bolt.
sentences.zh: 但这把锁的核心之处在于，它在钥匙和锁栓之间增加了复杂的层级。

sentences.en: It's like a whole Rube Goldberg scenario plays out inside the lock.
sentences.zh: 就像是一整套鲁布·戈德堡机械装置在锁内部运转。

sentences.en: The key touches one thing, which moves another thing, and triggers another thing.
sentences.zh: 钥匙触动一个部件，进而移动另一个部件，并触发又一个部件。

sentences.en: And Brahma was so confident in his lock that he actually published a pamphlet detailing exactly how it worked.
sentences.zh: 布拉马对他的锁极其自信，甚至出版了一本小册子，详细说明了它是如何运作的。

sentences.en: No more hiding the keyhole or shrouding the lock's operation in secrecy.
sentences.zh: 再也不需要隐藏钥匙孔或将锁的运作机制包裹在秘密之中了。

sentences.en: Brahma revealed everything about the lock and still claimed that it could not be opened without the key.
sentences.zh: 布拉马揭示了关于这把锁的一切，并且仍然声称没有钥匙就绝对打不开它。

sentences.en: And he also had another idea that would revolutionize locksmithing.
sentences.zh: 他还有另一个将彻底革新制锁业的想法。

sentences.en: He also contributes the idea of turning this whole thing into a conteSt.
sentences.zh: 他还提出了把这一切变成一场比赛的想法。

sentences.en: Showmanship.
sentences.zh: 展现实力。

sentences.en: So as soon as he has a padlock version of this lock that he is very confident in,
sentences.zh: 因此，一等他做出了非常有信心的挂锁版本，

sentences.en: he puts it in the window of his stored Piccadilly.
sentences.zh: 他就把它放在皮卡迪利大街自己店铺的橱窗里。

sentences.en: And he paints on it a message, a challenge, in gold lettering.
sentences.zh: 并且他在上面用金字写下了一条信息、一个挑战。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: The artist who can make an instrument that will pick or open this lock
sentences.zh: 能制造出撬开或打开这把锁的工具的工匠，

sentences.en: shall receive 200 guineas the moment it is produced.
sentences.zh: 一经做出即可获得200基尼的奖金。

sentences.en: 200 guineas in 1777 is something north of 20,000 British pounds today.
sentences.zh: 1777年的200基尼相当于今天超过20,000英镑。

sentences.en: And people try.
sentences.zh: 人们开始尝试。

sentences.en: People actually take a real honest shot at this.
sentences.zh: 人们真的认认真真地尝试挑战这个。

sentences.en: But no one, not even with their own tools, could hack it.
sentences.zh: 但没有人，即使带着他们自己的工具，也能搞定它。

sentences.en: And it remained in that window for 70 plus years, challenging all comers and everybody failed to open it.
sentences.zh: 它在那个橱窗里摆了70多年，向所有挑战者发出战书，而每个人都以失败告终。

sentences.en: Brahma's new unbeatable lock and the hoopla surrounding it caught the attention of the British crown.
sentences.zh: 布拉马崭新的无敌锁以及围绕它的一阵炒作引起了英国皇室的注意。

sentences.en: And they wanted to up the game.
sentences.zh: 他们想要把难度升级。

sentences.en: They wanted a lock that wouldn't just be unbreakable, but would also alert the owner if someone tried to get into it.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一把不仅无法被破解，而且在有人试图撬锁时还能警示主人的锁。

sentences.en: The government sponsored a contest with 100 British pounds as reward.
sentences.zh: 政府赞助了一场比赛，奖金为100英镑。

sentences.en: The best one at the time was Jeremiah Chubb's detector lock.
sentences.zh: 当时最好的作品是杰里米亚·查布的探测锁。

sentences.en: And the way that this worked is that when you lifted one of the tumblers up too high,
sentences.zh: 它的运作方式是，当你把其中一个不倒转子（弹子）抬得太高时，

sentences.en: it would actually trip a latching mechanism that would hold that tumbler up in the air too high,
sentences.zh: 它实际上会触发一个闩锁机构，把那个不倒转子卡在过高的空中，

sentences.en: and it wouldn't drop back down again.
sentences.zh: 而且它不会掉落回原位。

sentences.en: And when that happened, the lock would completely freeze up.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，锁就会完全卡死。

sentences.en: Even the key wouldn't open it.
sentences.zh: 连钥匙也打不开它。

sentences.en: Until you put a different key in, rotate it in the opposite direction, and reset all of the tumblers.
sentences.zh: 除非你插入另一把钥匙，向反方向旋转，并重置所有的不倒转子。

sentences.en: And so if you went to unlock a chest or a vault or your front door,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你去打开一个箱子、保险箱或你的前门，

sentences.en: and the key to your Chubb detector lock didn't work,
sentences.zh: 而你那把查布探测锁的钥匙不管用了，

sentences.en: you would know that someone had tried to get into it.
sentences.zh: 你就会知道有人曾试图闯入它。

sentences.en: And that they had failed.
sentences.zh: 而且他们失败了。

sentences.en: My name is Chubb that makes the patent locks.
sentences.zh: 我是制造专利锁的查布。

sentences.en: Look upon my works, ye burglars, in despair.
sentences.zh: 尔等江洋大盗，在我的杰作面前绝望吧。

sentences.en: And as these newer and better locks were getting invented,
sentences.zh: 正当这些更新更好的锁被发明出来时，

sentences.en: the public spectacle around them rose to a fever pitch.
sentences.zh: 公众围绕它们的狂热达到了白热化程度。

sentences.en: At one point they offered a guy in prison parole if he could break the Chubb lock.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他们向监狱里的一名囚犯承诺，如果他能破解查布锁就给他假释。

sentences.en: And this guy was a housebreaker.
sentences.zh: 而这家伙是个惯偷。

sentences.en: He had opened many locks in his life.
sentences.zh: 他一生中打开过很多锁。

sentences.en: And he tried it and tried it and tried it.
sentences.zh: 他试了又试，试了又试。

sentences.en: And literally his potential freedom was genuinely on the line.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上，他潜在的自由正悬于一线。

sentences.en: And he had to turn the thing back in and say he couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 而他不得不把锁交回去，并承认自己做不到。

sentences.en: And he couldn't imagine that anyone could do it.
sentences.zh: 而且他无法想象任何人能做到这一点。

sentences.en: And going forward, the names Brahma and Chubb are basically interchangeable for perfect security.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，“布拉马”和“查布”这两个名字基本上成了完美安全性的代名词。

sentences.en: But only until the Great Lock Controversy of 1851.
sentences.zh: 但这一切只持续到1851年的伟大锁具争端发生之前。

sentences.en: In 1851, an American named A.C.
sentences.zh: 1851年，一个名叫A.C.

sentences.en: Hobbs traveled to London for the Great Exhibition,
sentences.zh: 霍布斯的美国人前往伦敦参加万国博览会，

sentences.en: the first international exhibition of manufactured products.
sentences.zh: 这是第一届国际工业产品博览会。

sentences.en: Back in the States, Hobbs had made a name for himself as a sort of white hat security consultant.
sentences.zh: 回到美国后，霍布斯作为某种白帽安全顾问已经小有名气。

sentences.en: He'd go visit banks and say,
sentences.zh: 他会去拜访各大银行并说：

sentences.en: Hey, if I can break the lock on your safe, you want to buy one of mine?
sentences.zh: 嘿，如果我能撬开你们保险箱的锁，你们想买一个我的锁吗？

sentences.en: The banks would be like, yeah, sure, give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 银行会说，行啊，当然，试试吧。

sentences.en: And he was selling locks like crazy.
sentences.zh: 于是他的锁卖得火热。

sentences.en: Hobbs was a natural.
sentences.zh: 霍布斯是个天才。

sentences.en: And naturally, on day one of the exhibition,
sentences.zh: 不出所料，在博览会的第一天，

sentences.en: he publicly announced that he would pick the Chubb detector lock.
sentences.zh: 他公开宣布他将撬开查布探测锁。

sentences.en: The one that seizes up if you pick it incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 也就是那种如果撬错就会卡死的锁。

sentences.en: Hobbs successfully picked the Chubb detector lock in front of a crowd.
sentences.zh: 霍布斯在人群面前成功撬开了查布探测锁。

sentences.en: But the inventor, Jeremiah Chubb, wasn't convinced.
sentences.zh: 但发明者杰里米亚·查布并不信服。

sentences.en: He wanted to see Hobbs do it again.
sentences.zh: 他想看霍布斯再做一次。

sentences.en: So another trial was set, this time in front of auditors and reporters.
sentences.zh: 于是安排了又一次测试，这一次是在审计员和记者面前进行的。

sentences.en: And A.C.
sentences.zh: 而A.C.

sentences.en: Hobbs opened the lock again.
sentences.zh: 霍布斯再次打开了这把锁。

sentences.en: Take that, Chubb.
sentences.zh: 接招吧，查布。

sentences.en: He actually opened the lock pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 他其实挺快就打开了这把锁。

sentences.en: A witness wrote that it took Hobbs about 25 minutes.
sentences.zh: 一位目击者写道，霍布斯大约花了25分钟。

sentences.en: And the way Hobbs did it was to actually use the lock against itself.
sentences.zh: 霍布斯的方法实际上是利用锁自身的机制来对付它。

sentences.en: He would pick it until he tripped the detector mechanism, causing the lock to seize up.
sentences.zh: 他一直撬锁直到触发探测机构，导致锁卡死。

sentences.en: That would give Hobbs information about what was going on inside.
sentences.zh: 这会给霍布斯提供关于内部情况的信息。

sentences.en: And then he would pick the lock in the opposite direction to reset the detector.
sentences.zh: 然后他会向相反方向撬锁来重置探测器。

sentences.en: He'd go back and forth firing and resetting the detector
sentences.zh: 他来来回回地触发并重置探测器

sentences.en: until the lock told him everything he needed to know about how to get it open.
sentences.zh: 直到锁把如何打开它的全部信息都告诉了他。

sentences.en: And then he closed it again, and then he opened it again.
sentences.zh: 然后他又把它关上，接着又把它打开。

sentences.en: This time in seven minutes.
sentences.zh: 这次用了七分钟。

sentences.en: He had complete control over the Chubb lock.
sentences.zh: 他完全掌握了丘布特制锁。

sentences.en: It has absolutely been opened.
sentences.zh: 它绝对被打开了。

sentences.en: But the Chubb detector lock was really just a warm-up.
sentences.zh: 但丘布探测锁其实只是个热身。

sentences.en: The main event was the Brahma safety lock,
sentences.zh: 重头戏是布拉马安全锁，

sentences.en: the one with the challenge painted on it in gold lettering,
sentences.zh: 就是那个用金字写着挑战书的锁，

sentences.en: which had been sitting in Joseph Brahma's storefront window for 70 years,
sentences.zh: 它已经在约瑟夫·布拉马的店面橱窗里摆了70年，

sentences.en: unbeaten, taunting lock pickers everywhere.
sentences.zh: 未被破解，嘲弄着各地的开锁匠。

sentences.en: A.C.
sentences.zh: A.C.

sentences.en: Hobbs threw down the gauntlet.
sentences.zh: 霍布斯发起了挑战。

sentences.en: So a trial is conducted against the Brahma lock.
sentences.zh: 于是，针对布拉马锁的测试开始了。

sentences.en: They give him 30 days to conduct himself against it.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他30天的时间来对付它。

sentences.en: Joseph Brahma had died by this point, and his sons were running his shop.
sentences.zh: 此时约瑟夫·布拉马已经去世，他的儿子们在经营店铺。

sentences.en: They gave Hobbs a room above his store, and Hobbs got to work.
sentences.zh: 他们给霍布斯腾出了店面楼上的一个房间，霍布斯便开工了。

sentences.en: He was allowed to set the lock up in a way that was easy to work on,
sentences.zh: 他被允许以一种方便操作的方式安装这把锁，

sentences.en: and he could use all his own tools.
sentences.zh: 并且他可以使用他所有的专属工具。

sentences.en: Monitors would come check in on him periodically.
sentences.zh: 监督人员会定期来查看他的进展。

sentences.en: He winds up working on this thing for about 52 hours over the course of 14 days,
sentences.zh: 他在14天的时间里总共在这东西上花了大约52个小时，

sentences.en: and finally gets it open.
sentences.zh: 最后终于把它打开了。

sentences.en: And the way that he gets it open is much more like sort of brute forcing it.
sentences.zh: 而他打开它的方式更像是某种暴力破解。

sentences.en: He kind of designed a method of building a key for it.
sentences.zh: 他设计了一种为它制作钥匙的方法。

sentences.en: It wasn't super elegant.
sentences.zh: 这并不是非常优雅。

sentences.en: It couldn't be really easily repeated against a brand new one.
sentences.zh: 面对一把全新的锁，这种方法很难轻易复制。

sentences.en: And some of his methods could have been prevented with some slight alterations.
sentences.zh: 而且只要稍作改动，他的某些方法本是可以被阻止的。

sentences.en: But still, the Brahma lock had been opened.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，布拉马锁还是被打开了。

sentences.en: When Hobbs opened that lock, I swear to you, the world changed.
sentences.zh: 当霍布斯打开那把锁时，我向你发誓，世界变了。

sentences.en: Overnight, the feeling of perfect security had evaporated.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，绝对安全的感觉烟消云散。

sentences.en: And we have never gotten it back.
sentences.zh: 而我们再也找不回那种感觉了。

sentences.en: Locksmiths weren't able to convince the public that perfect security could be restored.
sentences.zh: 锁匠们无法说服公众，绝对安全可以失而复得。

sentences.en: But they did keep inventing new locks.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实一直在发明新的锁。

sentences.en: One such locksmith was Linus Yale Jr.
sentences.zh: 其中一位锁匠就是小林纳斯·耶鲁。

sentences.en: You've probably seen present-day locks with the name Yale on them.
sentences.zh: 你可能见过印有耶鲁名字的现代锁。

sentences.en: That's because Yale's company was able to mass-produce their locks
sentences.zh: 那是因为耶鲁的公司能够大规模生产他们的锁，

sentences.en: at a scale that no one ever had.
sentences.zh: 达到了前所未有的规模。

sentences.en: Their lock became the most common in the world.
sentences.zh: 他们的锁成为了世界上最常见的锁。

sentences.en: Yale's design, patented in 1851, the same year as the Great Lock Controversy,
sentences.zh: 耶鲁的设计于1851年获得专利，与“伟大的锁之争”同年，

sentences.en: was called the Pin and Tumbler Lock.
sentences.zh: 被称为弹子锁。

sentences.en: It's the kind of lock you see everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这就是你随处可见的那种锁。

sentences.en: If you live in an apartment building,
sentences.zh: 如果你住在公寓楼里，

sentences.en: this is almost certainly the same style of lock
sentences.zh: 这几乎可以肯定和你公寓大楼前门上的锁

sentences.en: as you have on your front door of your apartment building.
sentences.zh: 是同一种风格。

sentences.en: It's the kind of lock that Lee Honeywell taught me how to pick.
sentences.zh: 这就是李·亨尼韦尔教我怎么开的那种锁。

sentences.en: This is a design that's been, you know, really commercially successful
sentences.zh: 这是一个你知道的在商业上非常成功的的设计，

sentences.en: because it's super cheap to make and works pretty well.
sentences.zh: 因为制造极其便宜而且相当好用。

sentences.en: The Pin Tumbler Locks we have today are not too different
sentences.zh: 我们今天拥有的弹子锁，与一个世纪前制造的弹子锁

sentences.en: from the Pin Tumbler Locks manufactured a century ago.
sentences.zh: 没有太大区别。

sentences.en: And the common Pin Tumbler Lock is nowhere near as secure
sentences.zh: 而且普通的弹子锁的安全程度，远不及

sentences.en: as the beast that was the Brahma Safety Lock,
sentences.zh: 曾经那把令人生畏的布拉马安全锁，

sentences.en: which took one of the greatest minds in locksmithing
sentences.zh: 后者让制锁界最伟大的头脑之一

sentences.en: more than 50 hours to defeat.
sentences.zh: 花了50多个小时才将其攻克。

sentences.en: With about two hours of instruction and some practice,
sentences.zh: 只需大约两小时的指导和一些练习，

sentences.en: anyone, even you, can pick a simple door lock in a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 任何人，甚至是你，都可以在几分钟内打开一把简单的门锁。

sentences.en: And if you're feeling confident in your abilities,
sentences.zh: 如果你对自己的能力信心满满，

sentences.en: you can square off against other lock pickers.
sentences.zh: 你可以与其他开锁爱好者一较高下。

sentences.en: And that's our man Skylar Towne competing there
sentences.zh: 那正是我们的伙伴斯凯勒·汤恩在纽约市的一场比赛中

sentences.en: at a match in New York City.
sentences.zh: 进行竞技的画面。

sentences.en: He's also competed in arguably the World Cup of Locksport,
sentences.zh: 他甚至还参加过堪称锁艺世界杯的赛事，

sentences.en: the Dutch Open.
sentences.zh: 荷兰公开赛。

sentences.en: Competitive lock sport these days
sentences.zh: 如今的竞技锁艺

sentences.en: isn't so much about whether the locks can be beaten.
sentences.zh: 与其说是在于锁是否能被破解，

sentences.en: They're more about how fast you can beat them.
sentences.zh: 不如说是在于你破解它们的速度有多快。

sentences.en: And the locks used for competitions
sentences.zh: 比赛中使用的锁

sentences.en: are often a lot more complicated than your average door lock.
sentences.zh: 通常比你普通的门锁要复杂得多。

sentences.en: The lock on your door is so easily subverted.
sentences.zh: 你门上的锁是那么容易被攻破。

sentences.en: Just casually subverted, really, on most people's doors.
sentences.zh: 说真的，在大多数人的门上，随随便便就能被攻破。

sentences.en: With some skill and patience with a tension wrench and lock pick set,
sentences.zh: 只要有一点技巧、耐心、一个张力扳手和一套开锁工具，

sentences.en: you can get into almost anyone's house.
sentences.zh: 你就能进几乎任何人的家。

sentences.en: But you don't even need that much.
sentences.zh: 但你甚至不需要那么多。

sentences.en: Just a few seconds with a crowbar or a brick through a window
sentences.zh: 只需用撬棍花几秒钟，或者用砖头砸碎窗户，

sentences.en: will do the job nicely.
sentences.zh: 就能轻松搞定。

sentences.en: I mean, our homes are incredibly porous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们的家是极其脆弱的。

sentences.en: The locks in place now at banks and other high-security venues
sentences.zh: 现在银行和其他高安全场所使用的锁

sentences.en: are light years beyond what they had in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 比19世纪的锁先进了不知多少光年。

sentences.en: But the average consumer-grade locks didn't evolve nearly as much.
sentences.zh: 但普通消费级的锁并没有发生太大的演变。

sentences.en: It's not that we don't need locks.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们不需要锁。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 我们需要。

sentences.en: We just don't need them to be impenetrable.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不需要它们固若金汤。

sentences.en: What we're actually trusting is not the lock.
sentences.zh: 我们真正信任的其实不是锁。

sentences.en: What we're trusting is our community.
sentences.zh: 我们信任的是我们的社区。

sentences.en: We're trusting this sort of social order.
sentences.zh: 我们信任这种社会秩序。

sentences.en: And what the lock is now, the lock is a social construct
sentences.zh: 现在的锁，既是一个机械结构，

sentences.en: as much as it is a mechanical construct.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上也是一个社会建构。

sentences.en: And so in a post-perfect security world,
sentences.zh: 所以在绝对安全不复存在的时代，

sentences.en: most of the locks that we interact with every day
sentences.zh: 我们每天接触的大多数锁

sentences.en: don't inspire us to trust them.
sentences.zh: 并没有激发我们去信任它们。

sentences.en: They inspire us to trust each other.
sentences.zh: 它们激发的是我们去信任彼此。

sentences.en: And that's why a $15 lock from your local hardware store
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你当地五金店里十五美元的锁

sentences.en: will probably suffice.
sentences.zh: 可能就足够了。

sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由萨姆·格林斯潘制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Avery Truffleman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 合作者包括凯蒂·明格、艾弗里·特雷弗曼，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 KALW 电台的项目，

sentences.en: and produced at the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 并在 ArcSign 的办公室制作，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于美丽动人的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.zh: 我们都在 Twitter、Tumblr、Instagram 和 Spotify 上。

sentences.zh: 但你可以在 99pi.org 上解开《99%隐形》这把锁。

sentences.zh: 视频乌托邦。

sentences.zh: 视频乌托邦。
